newsitem.title: LEBANON: BANK OF LEBANON ISSUES CDS WORTH 58 BLN POUNDS.
newsitem.headline: BANK OF LEBANON ISSUES CDS WORTH 58 BLN POUNDS.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon said it issued on Thursday certificates of deposit dated June 20 to commercial banks worth 58 billion Lebanese pounds.
These included 57 billion pounds worth of 60-day CDs at an annual interest rate of 12.25 percent and one billion pounds worth of 45-day CDs at 11.5 percent.
This compared with the sale of 74 billion pounds worth of 60-day CDs at 12.5 percent last week. No sales were made in 45-day CDs carrying 11.75 percent annual interest.
